evidence.quote: Today I want to focus on one of the most important of those segments--the provision of credit to small businesses--and to explore how the traditional role of community banks may be affected by the growing role of online lenders.
As regulators, we also want to help the various stakeholders anticipate and carefully manage the associated risks.
I remain confident that community bankers will continue to play a vital role in the small business lending landscape
